purpose: Machine-readable control record. Companion to measurements.json; prose in CONTROLS.md.

control_types.independent_verification: the same value obtained by a second method that shares no code with the first
control_types.deliberate_perturbation: change the input the reader claims to read; the reading must change with it
control_types.fresh_process_repeat: same answer from a separate process invocation
control_types.adjacent_negative: something at the same boundary that must NOT change, and does not
control_types.operand_classification: every operand of the decisive instruction block identified
